changelog: - **Every zod upper bound now fits the column behind it, and CI keeps it that way** (#2262, the remainder of #1433). A cap wider than its `VARCHAR(191)` column let long text pass validation and die in the `INSERT` with Prisma P2000 — which no route handles, so the user got a 500 for input the form had just accepted. Fixed at the bound rather than by widening columns: `Project.name` (200), `Project.repoUrl`/`demoUrl`/`boardUrl` (500), `Goal.title` (200), `MeetingRequest.topic` (300), `Document.title` (200), `Organization.brandName`/`supportEmail` (200) and `ssoIssuer` (500), `MentorApplication.linkedinUrl` (500), `CompanyInquiry.email` (200), plus `Organization.brandColor` and the profile fields `city`, `university`, `department`, `linkedinUrl`, `githubUrl`, `portfolioUrl`, which had **no** cap at all on either side. Each limit is a named constant in `src/lib/textLimits.ts` used by the server schema, the client schema and the input's `maxLength`. New `npm run check:text-limits` (in `ci.yml`) reads the registry that moved out of `e2e/text-limits-columns.unit.spec.ts` into `src/lib/textLimitsRegistry.ts` and enforces it in both directions for 12 models: every `String` column accounted for (a constant, or an exemption with a written reason), no stale row, the constant fits the width parsed from `prisma/schema.prisma`, and every guarding file references the constant instead of a literal. The invariant used to be checked only by the scheduled full suite, so a too-wide cap merged green and surfaced on the first long paste; the check reads nothing but files, so it now runs in the PR gate. Two entries of the issue's table were **not** violations and are left alone — `ProjectTaskTemplate.title` was already fixed by #1433, and the `description`/`goals` fields it lists are `@db.Text` rather than `VARCHAR(191)` (they gain constants anyway, so no literal is left in those routes).

en: Long text in a project name, goal title, meeting topic, document title, organisation setting or profile field is now refused by the form with a clear message instead of failing with a server error after you press save.
tr: Proje adı, hedef başlığı, toplantı konusu, belge başlığı, kuruluş ayarları ve profil alanlarına uzun metin girildiğinde artık kaydettikten sonra sunucu hatası almıyorsunuz; form bunu baştan ve açık bir mesajla reddediyor.
de: Zu langer Text in einem Projektnamen, Zieltitel, Meeting-Thema, Dokumenttitel, in den Organisationseinstellungen oder in Profilfeldern wird jetzt direkt im Formular mit einer klaren Meldung abgelehnt, statt nach dem Speichern in einem Serverfehler zu enden.
